events.title: Mistral launches Voxtral 3 for production voice agents
events.title_zh: Mistral 推出面向生产语音 agent 的 Voxtral 3
events.summary: Mistral has released Voxtral 3, a speech stack spanning batch and real-time transcription, text-to-speech and a voice-agent SDK. The API is available through European, US and global endpoints. Prices start at $0.0035 per minute for transcription, $0.008 per minute for real-time transcription and $13 per million characters for TTS. Mistral says the family supports more than 50 transcription languages and more than 35 TTS languages; benchmark results are vendor-run.
events.summary_en: Mistral has released Voxtral 3, a speech stack spanning batch and real-time transcription, text-to-speech and a voice-agent SDK. The API is available through European, US and global endpoints. Prices start at $0.0035 per minute for transcription, $0.008 per minute for real-time transcription and $13 per million characters for TTS. Mistral says the family supports more than 50 transcription languages and more than 35 TTS languages; benchmark results are vendor-run.

events.why_it_matters: For teams building voice agents, Voxtral 3 combines speech input, speech output and tool use behind one production surface with explicit regional hosting. The price is low enough for a one-day latency and accuracy trial, but vendor benchmark charts do not replace evaluation on noisy calls, accents and domain vocabulary.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building voice agents, Voxtral 3 combines speech input, speech output and tool use behind one production surface with explicit regional hosting. The price is low enough for a one-day latency and accuracy trial, but vendor benchmark charts do not replace evaluation on noisy calls, accents and domain vocabulary.

events.title: ALTK-Evolve adds learned memory to customer-service agents
events.title_zh: ALTK-Evolve 为客服 agent 加入可学习记忆
events.summary: IBM Research and Hugging Face report that ALTK-Evolve learns reusable prompt-level guidance from completed customer-service episodes. On a held-out τ²-bench airline set, the authors report a ten-point gain for GPT-5.5 over 20 tasks repeated four times. The Apache-2.0 implementation is public, but the results come from the project team and cover a small benchmark slice rather than live customer traffic.
events.summary_en: IBM Research and Hugging Face report that ALTK-Evolve learns reusable prompt-level guidance from completed customer-service episodes. On a held-out τ²-bench airline set, the authors report a ten-point gain for GPT-5.5 over 20 tasks repeated four times. The Apache-2.0 implementation is public, but the results come from the project team and cover a small benchmark slice rather than live customer traffic.
events.summary_zh: IBM Research 与 Hugging Face 称，ALTK-Evolve 能从已完成的客服任务中学习可复用的 prompt 级指导。在 τ²-bench 的 held-out 航空子集上，作者报告 GPT-5.5 在 20 个任务、每题重复 4 次的测试中提高 10 个百分点。Apache-2.0 实现已公开，但结果来自项目团队，覆盖的是小型 benchmark 切片，不是真实客服流量。
events.why_it_matters: For agent teams, the interesting claim is not another vector store but a memory layer that turns prior outcomes into editable instructions. The public code makes a bounded trial possible; teams should test whether gains survive unseen policies and whether bad episodes poison later behavior.
events.why_it_matters_en: For agent teams, the interesting claim is not another vector store but a memory layer that turns prior outcomes into editable instructions. The public code makes a bounded trial possible; teams should test whether gains survive unseen policies and whether bad episodes poison later behavior.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 agent 团队来说，关键不是再加一个向量库，而是把历史结果整理成可编辑指令的记忆层。公开代码足以支持小范围试验；还要验证它能否迁移到没见过的政策，以及失败轨迹会不会污染后续行为。

events.title: OpenAI publishes MultiLangBench for low-resource coding
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布低资源编程语言评测 MultiLangBench
events.summary: OpenAI has published MultiLangBench, an Apache-2.0 benchmark covering 20 programming languages with less public training data, including COBOL, Fortran and Visual Basic. OpenAI reports GPT-6 Astra averaging an 87.4% test pass rate versus 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol. The repository contains public tasks and tests, but the headline model results are vendor-run and do not by themselves show production migration quality.
events.summary_en: OpenAI has published MultiLangBench, an Apache-2.0 benchmark covering 20 programming languages with less public training data, including COBOL, Fortran and Visual Basic. OpenAI reports GPT-6 Astra averaging an 87.4% test pass rate versus 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol. The repository contains public tasks and tests, but the headline model results are vendor-run and do not by themselves show production migration quality.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 MultiLangBench，这是一个 Apache-2.0 benchmark，覆盖 COBOL、Fortran、Visual Basic 等 20 种公开训练材料较少的编程语言。OpenAI 报告 GPT-6 Astra 的平均测试通过率为 87.4%，GPT-5.6 Sol 为 26.8%。题目与测试已公开，但头部模型结果仍是厂商评测，不能直接代表生产迁移质量。
events.why_it_matters: For teams maintaining legacy systems, public tests make it possible to compare models on languages that mainstream coding benchmarks mostly ignore. Treat test pass rate as a narrow code-correctness signal, then add repository conventions, integration tests and human review before using it to plan a migration.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams maintaining legacy systems, public tests make it possible to compare models on languages that mainstream coding benchmarks mostly ignore. Treat test pass rate as a narrow code-correctness signal, then add repository conventions, integration tests and human review before using it to plan a migration.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护遗留系统的团队来说，公开测试让 COBOL、Fortran 等主流 coding benchmark 很少覆盖的语言有了可比基线。测试通过率只是狭窄的代码正确性信号；拿它规划迁移前，还要加入仓库规范、集成测试和人工复核。

events.title: DeepSeek open-sources its production inference engine DeepInfer
events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源生产推理引擎 DeepInfer
events.summary: DeepSeek has released DeepInfer, the Apache-2.0 inference engine behind its production services. The first public version supports DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, with optimized kernels, parallelism, asynchronous scheduling, deterministic sampling and structured output. It currently provides offline inference and omits the KV-cache, disaggregated-serving and replica load-balancing layers needed for a complete online service.
events.summary_en: DeepSeek has released DeepInfer, the Apache-2.0 inference engine behind its production services. The first public version supports DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, with optimized kernels, parallelism, asynchronous scheduling, deterministic sampling and structured output. It currently provides offline inference and omits the KV-cache, disaggregated-serving and replica load-balancing layers needed for a complete online service.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 以 Apache-2.0 开源其生产服务使用的推理引擎 DeepInfer。首个公开版本支持 NVIDIA SM100 GPU 与华为 Ascend 950 NPU 上的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，包含优化 kernel、并行、异步调度、确定性采样和结构化输出。当前只提供离线推理，完整在线服务还缺 KV cache、分离式 serving 和副本负载均衡。
events.why_it_matters: For teams self-hosting DeepSeek models, DeepInfer exposes production-oriented scheduling and determinism mechanisms that were previously harder to reproduce from model weights alone. The hardware and service boundaries are narrow, so it is a trial target rather than a drop-in replacement for vLLM or SGLang.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams self-hosting DeepSeek models, DeepInfer exposes production-oriented scheduling and determinism mechanisms that were previously harder to reproduce from model weights alone. The hardware and service boundaries are narrow, so it is a trial target rather than a drop-in replacement for vLLM or SGLang.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对自托管 DeepSeek 模型的团队来说，DeepInfer 公开了仅靠模型权重难以复现的生产调度与确定性机制。但它的硬件和服务边界仍窄，更适合作为试验对象，不是 vLLM 或 SGLang 的直接替代品。
